source.base_task: View the speakers that are bluetooth and wireless and filter the results to only show models that are on sale and cost less than $50.

i0.content: On Best Buy, find wireless Bluetooth speakers that cost less than $50 and show the results.

revisions.content: I prefer a deal if one is available. If the results page has an On Sale (Current Deals) filter, also restrict to On Sale and name one matching product and its price; otherwise keep the under-$50 results and name one matching product and its price without requiring a sale.

milestones.semantic_concept: A Best Buy results list for wireless Bluetooth speakers with an under-$50 price filter applied (or clearly available) is displayed, so an On Sale deal filter can be checked next.

branch_policy.condition_text: The Best Buy results page for wireless Bluetooth speakers shows an On Sale filter under Current Deals (or equivalent On Sale deal facet) that can be applied to the results.

constraints.description: If no On Sale filter is available, the final answer must name one matching under-$50 product and its price without requiring the item to be on sale
If an On Sale filter is available, the final answer must name one on-sale product under $50 and its price
